overview: For electrical characterization of conductive films and wafers, including process qualification of metal transducers and electrically active layers used in thermal experiments. It does not directly measure thermal conductivity.
overviewZh: 用于导电薄膜与晶圆电学表征，可辅助评估热学实验中的金属传感层和有源层工艺质量，但不直接测量热导率。
principle: Outer probes source current and inner probes sense voltage with negligible current draw, reducing lead and contact-resistance errors. A geometry factor converts V/I into sheet resistance; resistivity additionally requires film thickness. Finite size, unequal spacing, multilayers and self-heating require appropriate corrections.
principleZh: 外侧探针通入电流，内侧探针以近似不取电流的方式测量电压，降低引线和接触电阻误差。结合几何因子，由 V/I 得到方阻，再结合膜厚得到电阻率。有限尺寸、非等距探针、多层导电与自热影响需适当修正。
